[S1:p7] Tulsa Storage OM.pdf (Page 7) - Investment Highlights
Investment Highlights

Marcus & Millichap is pleased to present an exclusive opportunity to acquire Tulsa Storage Units & Parking, a premier self-storage facility located in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The property features a diverse mix of 205 units, including 133 non-climate-controlled units, two covered parking spaces, 68 uncovered parking spaces, and two leased residential spaces. The facility is comprised of metal standing seam roofs, a leasing office connected to a 1,000 square-foot manager's residence, perimeter fencing and lighting, a key-pad gate system, 24-hour camera surveillance, and automated remote leasing technology.
Compared to most secondary markets in Oklahoma, Tulsa, driven by its diverse industrial and technological sectors, continues to attract substantial economic investment. Notably, in May 2023, Enel Green Power announced the largest economic development project in Oklahoma's history. With an investment exceeding one-billion dollars, Enel is establishing a solar panel manufacturing facility at the Tulsa Port of Inola, expected to generate 1,000 permanent jobs by 2025, with potential for further expansion. Additionally, the American Heartland Theme Park, a two-billion-dollar development, is projected to create around 4,000 jobs, drawing significant tourism to the area. Moreover, Tulsa's designation as a Tech Hub by the U.S. Economic Development Administration is anticipated to add 56,000 tech-related jobs over the next decade, further strengthening the local economy. These developments, alongside Tulsa's established aerospace, energy, and manufacturing sectors, reinforce the region's status as a compelling area for investment.
As of September 2024, 36 percent of the facility's tenants are paying rental rates below the current street rate, resulting in a monthly variance of $868, or $10,410 annually. A new investor will have the opportunity to capture this additional revenue by raising existing tenants up the current street rates. Separately, the property has the potential for future expansion by converting the 56 uncovered parking spaces into non-climate-controlled storage units, which could yield an estimated $0.50 increase in rent per square-foot in addition to the current $0.29 per square-foot. This could translate into an approximate $10,200 monthly or $122,400 annual increase in rental income, presenting a significant value-add opportunity. Although these projections are not currently reflected in the pro-forma operating statement, they represent substantial potential for future revenue growth.

Lane Prairie Self Storage is a 204-unit facility located in Joshua, Texas, located within the greater Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Potential tenants call the facility's phone number, speak to the owner about pricing, meet them on-site, and physically sign a lease on the premises. As a result, the property offers a significant operational value-add opportunity through modernization, online leasing, and professional management. There is a semi-converted 5 x 10 unit that a new owner could choose to utilize as an office moving forward, but phone and internet connections would have to be installed. The purchase includes a 50-year cell tower lease, executed in June 2025, which will generate $1,500 in monthly income starting in April 2026. [S3:p7] Lane Prairie OM - 2026.pdf (Page 7) - INVESTMENT OVERVIEW
INVESTMENT OVERVIEW

Lane Prairie Self Storage is a 204-unit facility located in Joshua, Texas, located within the greater Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. The facility consists of a mix of drive-up units, covered parking spaces, and uncovered parking spaces totaling 28,030 rentable-square feet. The entire parcel is approximately 4.29 acres in size, approximately 1.90 of which is raw land that could be expanded upon. Built in 1996, the facility has been owner-operated, however, recent changes in personal circumstances began to seriously impede the owner's ability to proactively run the business at a day-to-day level. It should be noted that the facility has operated without an onsite leasing office, nor a website. Potential tenants call the facility's phone number, speak to the owner about pricing, meet them on-site, and physically sign a lease on the premises. As a result, the property offers a significant operational value-add opportunity through modernization, online leasing, and professional management. There is a semi-converted 5 x 10 unit that a new owner could choose to utilize as an office moving forward, but phone and internet connections would have to be installed. The purchase includes a 50-year cell tower lease, executed in June 2025, which will generate $1,500 in monthly income starting in April 2026. Additionally, several long-term tenants are leasing at rates below current street rates, resulting in a conservative estimate of more than $17,000 in annual lost rental revenue (see Broker for details).
At a $1,500,000 purchase price, a new owner will be purchasing the property at a 7.33 percent year-one cap rate, and a 12.22 percent projected cash-on-cash return below the facility's replacement cost at only $53.51 per rentable-square foot. The attractive year-one returns, coupled with a legitimate opportunity for future value creation, makes Lane Prairie Storage an attractive acquisition target - particularly when considered against the backdrop of a local market that is in the middle of an unprecedented growth phase precipitated by the development of the Chisholm Trail Parkway in 2014. The Chisholm Trail Parkway is a 27.6-mile, controlled-access toll road operated by the NTTA connecting downtown Fort Worth (I-30) to Cleburne (US-67). The Parkway significantly reduced travel times between Tarrant and Johnson counties, and the growth - from both a population and economic perspective - has been exceptional. To be sure, in May 2025 the North Texas Tollway Authority announced they will now expand the Parkway from two to four lanes between Cleburne and Crowley to accommodate this growth. The right-of-way was purchased when the toll road was built, which should accelerate the project toward a quick completion date of Fall 2028. The growth of the Chisholm Trail corridor certainly hasn't been missed by online retailer Amazon, which is nearing completion of a massive 1.7 million-square-foot operations facility off the Chisholm Trail Parkway at Industrial Drive. Cleburne officials said the capital investment in the area will be $200 million and the project will create an estimated 800 to 1,000 jobs once fully operational. Lane Prairie Self Storage is located approximately three miles from the Amazon center, two miles away from the Chisholm Trail Parkway and is located outside both the Joshua city limits and its Extra- Territorial Jurisdiction (ETJ).
